description: The bar chart, titled "Model Evaluation on Academic and Practical Benchmarks," compares the performance of two models—LLaMA-3-8B-it (blue bars) and Ours (Iterative RLHF) (orange bars)—across ten different datasets and metrics. The vertical axis represents the score in percentage (%), ranging from 0 to 80 with major tick marks at intervals of 10. The horizontal axis lists the datasets and metrics, including GSM-8K, MMLU, HumanEval, TruthfulQA, ARC, MBPP, LC AlpacaEval-2, MT-Bench (x5), and Chat-Arena-Hard. For each benchmark, two bars are shown side-by-side, with the blue bar consistently representing the LLaMA-3-8B-it model and the orange bar representing the proposed iterative RLHF model. In most benchmarks, the orange bar (Ours) is taller than the blue bar (LLaMA-3-8B-it), indicating superior performance. The highest scores are observed on the GSM-8K benchmark, where both models achieve scores above 75%. The lowest scores are on the Chat-Arena-Hard benchmark, where the LLaMA-3-8B-it model scores approximately 20% and the proposed model scores around 28%. The chart visually demonstrates that the proposed iterative RLHF approach generally outperforms the LLaMA-3-8B-it model across the evaluated benchmarks.
